===Levels 45–49, 65–84/91/99: Blackjacking===
[[File:Blackjack demo.gif|thumb|Blackjacking in action.]]
[[Blackjack]]ing bandits in [[Pollnivneach]] offers the fastest experience from level 45 to 49, and then from level 65 to 84. To blackjack, lure a bandit to an empty house where the other bandits cannot see them. Knock out the bandit and pickpocket them twice while they are unconscious. The timing is right when the player receives experience drops every two [[tick]]s. When failing a knock-out, quickly knock out the bandit again or pickpocket them with a full inventory to avoid entering into combat. If the bandit starts attacking, equip a different weapon and attempt to knock out the bandit to cancel combat.

There are three different types of bandits that can be blackjacked, but the method is the same for all of them.
* From level 45 to 55, blackjack level 41 [[Bearded Pollnivnian bandits]] who are wielding a blackjack.
* From level 55 to 65, blackjack level 56 [[Bandit (Pollnivneach)|Pollnivnian bandits]] who do not have a beard and are wielding a scimitar.
* From level 65 onwards, blackjack [[Menaphite Thug]]s located in the southern part of Pollnivneach.

Blackjacking requires level 45 Thieving, partial completion of [[The Feud]], and a blackjack of any kind. The type of blackjack does not matter for blackjacking. Wearing full [[rogue equipment]] is recommended for double loot per pickpocket, though this does not give extra experience. Use [[Saradomin brew]]s or other inventory-blocking food (such as [[pie]]s or [[curry]]) for healing. Bring the food in banknotes and unnote it at the [[Banknote Exchange Merchant]] next to the [[Pollnivneach general store.|general store]]. Alternatively, buy [[Jug of wine|jugs of wine]] from [[Faisal the Barman|Faisal]] at the [[The Asp & Snake Bar.|bar]] to the south.

The experience rates in the table below assume having good practice and include resupply time. The Saradomin brew rates assume unnoting the brews at the Banknote Exchange Merchant, and the wine rates buying the wines from the nearby bar. Expect lower rates when learning. At maximum efficiency, it is possible to gain up to 270,000–275,000 experience per hour at level 99.

Stealing artefacts offers faster experience from level 49 to 65, and the Pyramid Plunder minigame  offers faster experience past level 91, but this method remains viable up to level 99. This method is fairly click-intensive however, so consider alternative methods listed below.

If using this method from level 45 to 91, the player will make ~2,500,000 coins, or ~5,000,000 coins when wearing full rogue equipment. Rogue equipment is locked until level 50.

====Resetting aggressiveness====
[[File:Reset aggro blackjacking weapon.gif|thumb|Switching weapons to reset aggressiveness.]]
Failing to knock out a bandit will make them aggressive. When this happens, avoid pickpocketing a conscious bandit (without a full inventory) as getting stunned will lower experience rates. With quick enough reactions, it is possible to avoid getting into combat by doing the following:
*Keep trying to knock them out again. This is the best option but requires quick reactions.
*Pickpocket the bandit with a full inventory. The player will not actually pickpocket, but selecting the dialogue prompt will reset aggressiveness. You can attempt to knock-out again immediately after the dialogue prompt, even though you will appear stunned.

If the bandit starts attacking the player, the bandit cannot be pickpocketed or knocked out while in combat. To quickly get out of combat, unequip the blackjack or switch to a different weapon, and attempt to knock out the bandit. This will make the bandit stop attacking the player. Wait a few seconds before re-equipping the blackjack, and continue blackjacking.

====More information and tips====
To minimise mouse movement (similarly to training [[Construction]]), set NPC 'Attack' Options to "Hidden". Use resizable mode and zoom in. Set the camera angle so that when right-clicking on a bandit, the mouse cursor is on the "Pickpocket" option.
* On the [[RuneLite]] client, use the Menu Entry Swapper plugin to swap the Pickpocket option (on the unconscious bandit NPC) as left-click. Set the camera angle so that when right-clicking on a bandit, the mouse cursor is on the "Knock-Out" option. This way, the player can right-click knock out and left-click pickpocket the bandit without moving the mouse at all.

Lure a bandit to a spot where he gets trapped and cannot move elsewhere. Make sure the bandit is not able to walk through you; this can be done by knocking out the bandit, quickly running away from the bandit and going back in front of him. The bandit will not teleport to its respawn location as long as you keep blackjacking.

For bearded or regular Pollnivnian bandits, use [[Ali the dyer|Ali the Dyer]]'s house in the northern part of Pollnivneach. It is very small and has a ladder which can be used to quickly reset aggressiveness if needed. A Menaphite Thug can be lured into the southern part of the house just next to the bar.

Use [[inventory blocking food]] (such as Saradomin brews, pies, or jugs of wine) to always have a full inventory. With a full inventory, the player cannot get coin pouches and thus cannot actually pickpocket a conscious bandit. If the player fails a knock-out, quickly attempt to pickpocket a conscious bandit. This will cancel initial aggressiveness and minimises resets from entering combat, which will increase experience rates. Immediately knocking out the bandit is faster, so only use this as a backup tactic.

In addition, having a full inventory minimises the chance of getting stunned by accidentally pickpocketing a conscious bandit, which will also save time. If using Saradomin brews, disable automatic vial smashing to get an empty vial after drinking the potion.

Alternatively, have a maximum stack of coin pouches for the same effect. This is generally worse than using inventory-blocking food however, because getting a maximum stack of coin pouches takes a notable amount of time.
